info.name: Stroke Risk Monitoring API
info.description:
IBM Granite-powered stroke risk monitoring — all five agents + report summary.
Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api/v1

request.description:
Assess overall stroke risk for a patient.

Returns: risk_score (0-100), risk_level (Low/Moderate/High/Critical), key_factors, summary, recommendation.

Classify a BP reading and analyse the recent trend.

Returns: classification, trend, trend_summary, requires_immediate_attention (bool), action.

⚠️ requires_immediate_attention=true means Hypertensive Crisis — trigger immediate alert.

Analyse longitudinal trends for glucose, cholesterol, and BMI over the last 30 readings.

Returns: per-metric trend direction, alerts[] for threshold breaches, overall_trend, narrative.

Generate a personalised lifestyle health plan (diet, exercise, smoking, stress, medication adherence).

Optional: risk_level (pre-computed from Agent 1 output).
Guidelines: WHO / AHA / NHS.

Assess reported symptoms for FAST stroke warning signs.

⚠️ SAFETY: If urgency=EMERGENCY is returned, trigger immediate alert and display the emergency_message to the user.

Extract stroke-relevant information from a hospital discharge report.

Returns: key_diagnoses, relevant_medications, BP/glucose/cholesterol readings, cardiovascular_history, summary.

Only the first 3000 characters of report_text are processed.
